class.name: NetwBitStream
class.brief_description: One bit vocabulary in three modes, so a payload is described once and written, read and measured by the same code.

method.name: align_verify
method.description: Pads to the next byte boundary when writing, and when reading refuses padding whose bits are not zero. Returns [code]false[/code] on refusal, which poisons the stream.

method.name: bit_length
method.description: Bits spent so far: written, read, or described, according to [method get_mode].

method.name: bits
method.description: Spends [param count] raw bits of [param value], at most 64, and answers what was spent. Reading answers the decoded bits; a [param count] outside [code]1[/code] to [code]64[/code] is refused.

method.name: bits_remaining
method.description: Bits the reader has not consumed, and [code]0[/code] in any other [enum Mode]. A whole payload ends at [code]0[/code].

method.name: bytes_capped
method.description: Spends a length wide enough for [param cap], then the bytes. A run longer than [param cap] is refused by the writer, and a declared length above [param cap] is refused by the reader, so the bound is checked on both sides rather than trusted from the wire.

method.name: get_mode
method.description: Which of the three modes this stream was made in. It never changes.

method.name: int_range
method.description: Spends exactly the bits the span [param low] to [param high] needs. A [param value] outside the span is refused by the writer and a decoded value outside it is refused by the reader, so an enum on the wire cannot arrive as a case the game has no branch for.

method.name: measurer
method.description: A stream in [constant MEASURE] that stores nothing and counts what a description would cost. This is how a payload is priced before it is built.

method.name: ok
method.description: Whether the stream is still healthy. A read that ran past the end, a refused bound, or padding that was not zero clears this and it never comes back.

method.name: reader
method.description: A stream in [constant READ] over [param bytes].

method.name: string
method.description: Spends the utf8 of [param value] as a [method bytes_capped] run of at most 1023 bytes.

method.name: svarint
method.description: Spends a signed value as a zigzagged [method varuint], so a small negative number costs one group rather than ten.

method.name: to_bytes
method.description: What the writer has spent, padded to a whole byte. Empty in any other [enum Mode].

method.name: varuint
method.description: Spends an unsigned value as seven bit groups with a continuation bit, at most [param max_bytes] of them. Canonical and bounded: see the class description for what each end refuses.

method.name: writer
method.description: A stream in [constant WRITE], empty, ready to spend bits.

constants.constant: The stream spends the value it is given and [method to_bytes] answers the result.
The stream takes values back out of the bytes [method reader] was given, ignoring the value it is passed and answering it unchanged once the stream is poisoned.
The stream stores nothing and only counts, so [method bit_length] answers what the same description would cost to write.
